set_aside.subject: public_op:given_values.read_required_text
set_aside.text: “a value the owner gives the import's mapping, a display name … which migration_import.read_import_mapping shows as a missing value” conflicts with A16 rule 1: “its v1 name and no alias unless the owner gives others”
set_aside.question: When a picked project has a nonblank v1 name and the owner supplies no replacement display name, does the mapping use the v1 name or report a missing value and remain non-clean?
options: Use the v1 name as the imported display name.
Report the display name as missing until the owner explicitly supplies one.
set_aside.default_guess: Use the v1 name unless the owner supplies a replacement.

witness.initial: An accepted upload contains project P with v1 name “Reforma Centro”; the owner picks P and supplies no replacement display name.
events: The owner asks migration_import.read_import_mapping for the picked project.
outcomes: The mapping shows “Reforma Centro” as P's arrival name and may be clean.
The mapping reports P's display name missing and is not clean, so no confirmation step is shown.
witness.observer: The owner sees whether the import can proceed without re-entering the existing name.

set_aside.subject: public_op:migration_import.read_import_mapping
set_aside.text: “a Customer's name or kind” is read through read_required_text, which accepts every nonblank text unchanged, but read_import_mapping does not say how a nonblank kind outside the closed person/company vocabulary is represented or refused
set_aside.question: What does read_import_mapping return when an owner-supplied Customer kind is present and nonblank but is not person or company, and at which operation is it refused?
options: Return a non-clean mapping with a defect or missing-value item and let confirm_import refuse mapping_not_clean.
Treat it as present in the mapping and reject it only when confirmation rechecks the values.

witness.initial: A picked project names v1 customer value C, and all file records and production ids are otherwise clean.
events: The owner supplies C's name and kind “partnership”.
outcomes: The mapping request is immediately refused as outside_closed_list.
The mapping is returned, with the invalid kind deferred to a non-clean mapping or to confirmation.
witness.observer: The owner sees either an immediate request refusal or a mapping page and a later refusal.
